name: HVAC Maintenance Checklist
description: An HVAC maintenance checklist covering filters, coils, thermostat and professional service.

items.text: Check the air filter monthly and replace it when dirty
items.note: Replace 1-inch filters at least every 90 days

items.text: Match the filter size and MERV rating to your system
Replace filters more often with pets, allergies or smoke
Keep spare filters on hand so you never delay a change
Write the install date on the filter frame to track changes
Clear leaves, grass and debris from around the unit
Keep at least two feet of clearance on all sides
Gently rinse the condenser fins with a hose
items.note: Turn off power at the disconnect before cleaning

items.text: Straighten bent fins carefully with a fin comb
Check that the unit sits level on its pad
Vacuum dust from the blower compartment when power is off
Check the evaporator coil for dirt and have a pro clean if needed
Clear the condensate drain line and pan of clogs and slime
Inspect the drain pan for standing water or rust
Listen for unusual rattles, squeals or grinding noises
Test heating and cooling modes for correct response
Replace thermostat batteries once a year
Program schedules to cut runtime when you're away or asleep
Confirm the displayed temperature matches a separate thermometer
Update settings each season for heating or cooling
Keep supply and return vents clear of furniture and rugs
Vacuum dust from registers and grilles
Check accessible ducts for gaps, leaks or loose connections
Seal small duct leaks with mastic or foil tape, not cloth duct tape
Consider a professional duct inspection every few years
Book a cooling tune-up in spring and a heating tune-up in fall
Have the technician check refrigerant levels and pressures
Ask them to inspect electrical connections and tighten as needed
Have the heat exchanger inspected for cracks on gas furnaces
items.note: A cracked heat exchanger can leak carbon monoxide

items.text: Keep service records to track repairs and warranty coverage

faq.q: How often should I service my HVAC system?
faq.a: Schedule professional service twice a year — heating in fall and cooling in spring — and check or replace the air filter monthly during heavy use to keep airflow strong and efficiency high.

faq.q: Can I download this HVAC checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. You can print this HVAC maintenance checklist or download it as a PDF and keep it near the furnace so monthly and seasonal tasks are easy to track.

faq.q: How often should I change my HVAC filter?
faq.a: Check 1-inch filters monthly and replace them at least every 90 days, or more often with pets, allergies or heavy use. A clean filter protects the system and lowers energy use.

faq.q: What HVAC tasks should a professional handle?
faq.a: Leave refrigerant charging, electrical connections, gas components, and sealed-system repairs to a licensed HVAC technician. These involve safety hazards and specialized tools beyond routine DIY upkeep.

faq.q: Why does HVAC maintenance save money?
faq.a: A clean, tuned system uses less energy, cools and heats faster, and lasts longer. Regular service also catches small issues early, before they become expensive emergency repairs.
